Briefly fine-tunes NekoManga's dedicated AI (the model that assists with white bar lines) on the collected material, and shows a before/after comparison on held-out pages. The Aletheia Lens models are not trained. The model changes only when you click [Apply], and you can roll back at any time. Training uses the GPU and takes minutes to tens of minutes. When it starts, the colorization engine (ComfyUI — your linked ComfyUI, if you linked one) is shut down, and training does not start while a job is using that engine.
